info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Loan Payment API
info.description: The Update Loan Payment API allows users to modify existing payment details associated with a specific loan. By providing the loan ID and payment ID, consumers can update various attributes of the payment, such as amounts or payment dates. This API is typically used by financial institutions and service applications that need to manage loan payment processes efficiently. Utilize this endpoint to ensure that payment records are current and accurately reflect the latest transaction details.

put.summary: Update a payment for the specified loan.
put.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific payment associated with a loan identified by LOAN-500045. Ensure you provide the necessary payment information in the request body to successfully update the payment details.

requestBody.description: This request body updates the payment details for a specific loan. It should contain all necessary payment information such as amount, payment date, and any associated fees. Ensure to provide the correct format as outlined in the schema.
